name: Sugarloaf Canyon - world layout
units: studs (1 stud = 0.3 m), +Y up, map view +X east/right, -Z north/up. Same axes as Lantern Grove holes.json/world.json.

bounds.note: Terrain extent. Backdrop meshes sit outside it.

placement_convention.apply: For every (future) holes.json element of hole N: rotate its LOCAL x/z about +Y by placement.yaw_deg, then translate by placement.origin. x' = lx*cos(yaw) + lz*sin(yaw) + origin.x ; z' = -lx*sin(yaw) + lz*cos(yaw) + origin.z ; y' = ly + origin.y. Piece yaw_world = piece.yaw + yaw_deg. Positive yaw = counter-clockwise in the map view: yaw 0 plays north, 90 west, 180 south, -90 east. The local origin is the tee; play is toward local -Z.
placement_convention.roblox: holeRoot = CFrame.new(origin) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw_deg), 0); partCFrame = holeRoot * localCFrame. Axes rotate only.
placement_convention.concept_footprint: Until holes.json exists each hole is concept.pads: flat boxes in the local frame (x range, z range, y offset from origin.y). The future hole geometry (felt + rails + props within 2 studs) must stay inside them. concept.spans = local z ranges where the hole bridges a gap or river and the ground is not flattened.

sun.note: IN-GAME golden hour. ClockTime is approximate: calibrate geographic latitude/time in Studio to bearing 277, elevation 25. No tee plays within 45 deg of this bearing.

hero_render_sun.alignment_warning: Requested +2 deg is 1 deg ABOVE the arch top (+1), not inside the opening. Use only for hero renders; never override game lighting.

holes.name: Trailhead Gate
holes.gimmick: Bank shot: a striped boulder's 45-degree face turns the ball east onto an offset green
holes.landmark: Candy-striped trailhead arch with a hanging lollipop sign
holes.surroundings: Canyon floor at Sugarloaf Junction (y 18); boardwalk town to the east, Old Sugarloaf dome rising on the northern skyline

holes.name: Mine-Cart Junction
holes.gimmick: Tunnel choice: open-top 3-wide shortcut (left), gentle dead end (middle), shorter forgiving long haul (right)
holes.landmark: Mine-head with ore carts and a candy-striped headframe
holes.surroundings: Junction mine-head against a rock outcrop; Taffy Mesa's striped cliffs 80 studs east

holes.name: Ranger's Riverbend
holes.gimmick: River crossing: a rail-less log plank straight over the river (risky) or the railed ranger footbridge (safe); a ball in the river respawns at the plank entry
holes.landmark: Ranger station with a fire-lookout cupola on the west bank
holes.surroundings: Both banks of the Sugarloaf River; ranger station and lookout cupola on the west bank, West Ledge cliffs behind

holes.name: Crystal Corridor
holes.gimmick: Pinball crystals: static flat-faced rock-candy bumpers bounce the ball down the slot
holes.surroundings: Mouth of the Rock Candy Narrows: 52-stud slot walls, rock-candy crystals in the walls

holes.name: Echo Slot
holes.gimmick: Half-pipe: an S-bend U-channel with banked felt walls; ride high to carry the bend
holes.landmark: Smooth wave-carved slot walls in pink and cream bands
holes.surroundings: Deep in the Narrows at the slot's bend; only a ribbon of sunset sky overhead

holes.name: Flash Flood
holes.gimmick: Timing gate: a sluice gate slides across the slot neck, pauses closed, then opens (slide with dwell); the overflow channel is the safe way round
holes.landmark: Old sluice gate and flood-warning bell tower
holes.surroundings: Upper Narrows below the slot head; the Rock Candy Lift cage hangs on the wall

holes.name: Rope Bridge Run
holes.gimmick: Rope-bridge spans: two railed rope bridges over Taffy Gap with an island between whose ends are open to the gap; a fall respawns at the island
holes.landmark: Taffy Gap with two sagging rope bridges
holes.surroundings: Taffy Mesa top (y 70), crossing Taffy Gap; Old Sugarloaf and the dam in view

holes.name: Gumdrop Gulch
holes.gimmick: Rolling dips: gumdrop humps and hollows made of opposing planar slopes; pace the ball through
holes.landmark: Giant gumdrop boulders in candy colours
holes.surroundings: Open mesa top among gumdrop boulders, Butterscotch Butte to the east

holes.name: Lollipop Windmill
holes.gimmick: Vertical rotor: a windpump's lollipop vanes turn across the tunnel mouth; the bypass round the pump house is the safe way
holes.landmark: Windpump with lollipop vanes and a water tank
holes.surroundings: North end of Taffy Mesa by Licorice Slot; the Reservoir Bench cliff rises 46 studs to the north

holes.name: Sluice Chute
holes.gimmick: One-way slope: a steep sluice chute drops 3.6 studs into a basin green; felt arrows and chevrons show it is one-way
holes.landmark: Timber sluice flume with peppermint-striped gates
holes.surroundings: East end of the Reservoir Bench (y 116), looking south over the whole canyon

holes.name: Floodgate Lock
holes.gimmick: Ball elevator: a canal-lock platform lifts the ball 4 studs and comes back down; roll in while the lock gate is down
holes.landmark: Canal lock with brass winches and a lock-keeper's hut
holes.surroundings: Reservoir shore east of the dam; lock gates and the reservoir behind the green

holes.name: Intake Tower
holes.gimmick: Pipe teleport: sink the ball in the intake grate at the end of a rail-less pier and it shoots out of an outflow pipe by the green, or play the long shoreline route
holes.landmark: Domed intake tower standing in the reservoir
holes.surroundings: West shore beyond the dam; intake tower stands in the reservoir to the north-east

holes.name: Hoodoo Maze
holes.gimmick: Pillar maze: hoodoo pillars and striped rock make three corridors of different length and risk
holes.landmark: Cluster of striped hoodoo spires with balanced gumdrop caps
holes.surroundings: Hoodoo Bench (y 150) among striped hoodoo spires, Fizzwater Falls to the north

holes.name: Ore Bucket Swing
holes.gimmick: Pendulum: an ore bucket swings from a cableway trestle across the lane, before a ramp up to the raised loading-dock green
holes.landmark: Cableway trestle with a swinging ore bucket
holes.surroundings: Hoodoo Bench, under the old cableway that once carried ore buckets to the dam

holes.name: Sugar Dune
holes.gimmick: Side-slope reading: a long dune face tilted across the line, dropping to a two-tier green
holes.surroundings: Powdered-sugar dunes at the south end of the Hoodoo Bench; Sugarloaf Crown's north face ahead

holes.name: Sinkhole Drop
holes.gimmick: Drop between levels: putt into a sinkhole in the upper deck and fall 3.6 studs into a funnel bowl
holes.landmark: Crystal-lined sinkhole with a rope railing
holes.surroundings: Top of Sugarloaf Crown (y 190), the highest ground in the world

holes.name: Sundial
holes.gimmick: Four timed shadow arms sweep around a solid central plinth on a square green
holes.landmark: Giant stone sundial with candy-coloured hour stones
holes.surroundings: Crown summit plateau; panorama over every zone

holes.name: Sunset Arch
holes.gimmick: Finale: bank round a hoodoo, ramp up under the arch, then a geode-shortcut teleport or the rim route to a cliff-edge green
holes.landmark: Sunset Arch, a natural candy-striped stone arch on the west rim
holes.surroundings: West rim of the Crown with Sunset Arch framing the setting sun beside the green

terrain.method: Deterministic heightfield h(x,z) (tools/worldlib.py height_at), evaluated in order: (1) base: h = base.height + sum(amp*sin(2*pi*x/wx+px)*sin(2*pi*z/wz+pz)). (2) regions in list order. 'set': w = 1-smoothstep(d/falloff), d = distance outside the shape (0 inside); h += (height-h)*w. 'hill': h += peak*cos^2(pi/2*q), q = elliptical radius/radii < 1. 'superellipse_dome': within radius use exact base+height*sqrt(max(0,1-(r/radius)^exponent)); detail noise is suppressed on this feature. 'slot': along the polyline [x,z,floor,width] (linear between vertices) h = min(h, h + (floor-h)*(1-smoothstep((d-width/2)/wall))). (3) rim: q = superellipse radius; t = smoothstep((q-start)/(full-start)); h = max(h, height*(1+variation*sin(lobes*atan2+phase))*t + (1-t)*h); then detail_noise. (4) pads: every concept pad box flattened to its y, blended back over `falloff` beyond `margin`; inside a declared span h = min(natural, pad). (5) paths: within width/2+1 of a graded segment h = profile (stairs: profile - stair_bed_drop), blended over `shoulder`; segments on_hole/bridge/lift/gondola/dam_crest don't grade. (5b) pad clamp: pad boxes (outside spans) = pad y. (6) water: h = min(h, stream/lake carve profile); stream bank: level + bank_slope*(d - width/2) out to bank_reach, lake: beach then bank_slope out to bank_reach (no carve beyond). smoothstep(t) = t^2(3-2t), t clamped to [0,1].

path_rules.segment_types: on_hole (across the hole's own area), walk (<1% grade), ramp (<=10%), stairs (flight: steps x rise, tread), landing (flat), bridge (rope/plank bridge, railed), dam_crest (railed walkway on the dam), lift (vertical cage lift: start/end = boarding points), gondola (cable car)
path_rules.rails: seg.rails = ['left'|'right'...]: sides that need a railing because the ground drops > rail_drop studs within 2.5 studs of the walkway edge (left/right relative to walking direction). Bridges and dam crest: both.
